test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"an area."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The blank needs a noun that can fit in the context of the sentence. • **"An area"** is the most suitable option as it can refer to a specific space or region. (क्षेत्र, इलाक़ा) • **Example**: *An area__ was visited by my mother.* • The sentence says that established English Ivy may spread to cover an area of about 500 square feet per year with the right circumstances. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct paragraph: English Ivy __betrays__ its poor reputation as a nuisance by its unparalleled ability to provide shade. By seamlessly covering the exterior of a building, it works as a natural __insulator__, blocking the sun and decreasing air conditioning costs. This means big savings for both building tenants and homeowners __alike__. And it can happen quickly, too. Under the proper conditions, established English Ivy can grow to cover __an area__ of roughly 500 square feet per year. Given that most homes have a roof measuring roughly 2000 square feet, ivy-friendly homeowners can rest assured that their roofs will be ______ (5) ______ covered in about four years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"a lake" **refers to a large area of water that is surrounded by land. (झील, सरोवर) • Option 3, **"a surface" **refers to the outside part of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का बाहरी हिस्‍सा; सतह) • Option 4, **"a wall"** refers to a solid, vertical structure made of stone, brick, etc. that is built round an area of land to protect it or to divide it. (दीवार, दीवाल (किसी को दूसरे से अलग करने या उसकी सुरक्षा के लिए उसके चारों ओर बनाई गई)) 46:Tf4f, The correct answer is **"completely."**
